speaker: a007
text: Eron, I've got nothing — I didn't reach the pile in time and I'm sitting at satiation two, which means I need to eat before the year closes or I'm dead. Can you spare one food, and do you still have enough to keep yourself safe through winter?

speaker: a008
text: Sela. You're young, strong — and you've got nothing left to eat. I've got a bit to spare; I'm not asking for anything back, just want to know you're not going to collapse before winter's out.

speaker: a007
text: Mako, I've been watching you for four years and this is the first word you've said to anyone — so forgive me if I'm slow to take it as nothing more than kindness. I won't pretend I don't need food right now, but I'd want to know what you're actually building before I start counting myself as something you've helped.

speaker: a008
text: Fair enough. I kept to myself because there was nothing worth saying until now — the pile's empty and you're down to nothing while Bram's sitting on twelve. I'd rather have one person I can trust at my back than stay comfortable and quiet while that gap keeps growing.

speaker: a009
text: Ryn gathers Dav, Dell to talk.

speaker: a009
text: Pile's gone and I got nothing — Bram doubled back and took two more before I could reach it, and now I'm sitting on six food with a year to feed myself and no certainty about what Vela's doing with her two. Tell me what either of you saw at the pile, because someone moved fast and it wasn't this circle.
